title: Subtract Date From Date - Duration Calculation
description: Use Subtract Date From Date to calculate elapsed time between two timestamps.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "Diagnostic started at 14:00, ended at 14:15. How long did it take? Subtract Date From Date calculates the duration between two timestamps."
story.context: Subtracting dates gives elapsed time. Essential for performance measurement, timeout validation, and duration tracking.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Perfect! You calculated the diagnostic took 900 seconds (15 minutes). Duration calculation is critical for performance testing."

instructions: Create *** Settings *** section with Library    DateTime
hints: Subtract Date From Date returns seconds (as string)
Result is positive if date1 > date2
Convert To Number for arithmetic operations
solution:
*** Settings ***
Library    DateTime

*** Test Cases ***
Measure Diagnostic Duration
    ${start_time}=    Get Current Date
    Log    Diagnostic started
    Sleep    2s
    ${end_time}=    Get Current Date
    Log    Diagnostic completed
    ${duration}=    Subtract Date From Date    ${end_time}    ${start_time}
    Log    Duration: ${duration} seconds
    ${duration_num}=    Convert To Number    ${duration}
    Should Be True    ${duration_num} >= 2
    Should Be True    ${duration_num} < 3

Calculate Time Difference
    ${time1}=    Convert Date    2025-10-04 14:00:00    result_format=%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S
    ${time2}=    Convert Date    2025-10-04 14:15:00    result_format=%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S
    ${diff}=    Subtract Date From Date    ${time2}    ${time1}
    Log    Time difference: ${diff} seconds
    Should Be Equal As Numbers    ${diff}    900

theory.title: Exercise 4.3.3: Subtract Date From Date
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "How long did it take? How much time remains? Subtract Date From Date gives you the duration between two timestamps—essential for performance measurement."

Subtract Date From Date

Calculate time difference:

Library    DateTime

${start}=    Get Current Date
Sleep    5s
${end}=    Get Current Date

${duration}=    Subtract Date From Date    ${end}    ${start}
# Result: ~5.0 (seconds as string)

${elapsed}=    Convert To Number    ${duration}
# Convert for arithmetic

Result Format:

  • Default: seconds as string
  • Use result_format for custom units
  • Positive if date1 > date2
  • Negative if date1 < date2

Result Format Options:

${days}=    Subtract Date From Date    ${d2}    ${d1}    result_format=number
${verbose}=    Subtract Date From Date    ${d2}    ${d1}    result_format=verbose
# verbose: '2 days 3 hours 15 minutes'

Example: Performance Validation

*** Settings ***
Library    DateTime

*** Test Cases ***
Validate Response Time
    ${start}=    Get Current Date
    # API call or operation
    ${end}=    Get Current Date
    ${elapsed}=    Subtract Date From Date    ${end}    ${start}
    ${elapsed_num}=    Convert To Number    ${elapsed}
    Should Be True    ${elapsed_num} < 3    msg=Response too slow: ${elapsed}s

⚠️ Subtract Date From Date Tips

  • Returns seconds by default (as string)
  • Order matters: later_date minus earlier_date
  • Convert To Number for comparisons
  • Use for: duration, performance, timeout validation
  • result_format=verbose for human-readable output
